lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately seven horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank. Blobs posterior to the gill area are larger and more distinct, with irregular spacing between adjacent centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a rectilinear grid-like appearance, most prominent in the central region of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, marked by a sharp pixel intensity gradient transitioning from high luminance on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped indentation or notch is visible on the trailing (posterior) edge of the pectoral fin, roughly midpoint along the fin's length.
other_distinctive_markers: Dynamic caustic light patterns from the water surface are projected across the dorsal-lateral surface, creating secondary, fluctuating high-intensity pixel clusters that overlay the anatomical markings.
